thread:
Maria: Can the rule editor surface an "estimated notify fanout"? I want a quick number in the UI before saving a rule.
Sam: We can, but it will be an estimate. Final delivery depends on dedupe, escalation paths, and live quotas.
Alex: Proposal: add a lightweight `fanout_preview` field on the rule-preview API. Return counts by channel (email/sms/pager) and an overall estimate.
Maria: UI copy idea: 'Estimated recipients: ~38 (email 21 · pager 12 · sms 5)'. Tooltip: 'Estimate excludes contact identifiers and may differ at send time.'
Jim: Concern: computing this in-editor shouldn't call the full notify pipeline. That would be too slow and expensive.
Alex: Agreed. Fast path: compute from cached contact mappings + dedupe heuristic. Response shape example: `{"estimate": 38, "breakdown": ["email:21","pager:12","sms:5"], "dedupe_factor": 0.7, "quota_prediction": "none"}`
Olivia: Telemetry: we should not log every preview event. Sample (1%) and emit aggregate metrics: preview_requests, avg_estimate, preview_errors.
Sam: Also surface whether the tenant has notify quotas that might reduce fanout (so console users understand risk). The fast path can tag `quota_possible: true` if tenant has non-zero quota usage.
Maria: Security: only allow previews for rules scoped to the requesting tenant. No cross-tenant visibility.
Jim: Perf targets: fast path <200ms. If include_quota=true (heavier path that consults quota service) allow up to 500ms but mark UI as 'more accurate estimate (may take a moment)'.
Alex: Add an API flag `?estimate_mode=fast|accurate`. Default fast. Accurate path will consult rate-limit store and recent sends.
Olivia: Add ACL audit event (who previewed which rule id) but don't include contact details. Helps compliance.
Sam: Implementation steps: 1) API contract + privacy checklist. 2) backend cached mapper + dedupe heuristics. 3) optional quota consult behind flag. 4) telemetry sampling + feature flag rollout.
Maria: I'll mock a compact UI widget and microcopy. Keep it unobtrusive, small text under the notification config.
Alex: I'll open a PR with API examples and a small privacy note.
Jim: I'll validate that cached mapping can be kept warm without adding too much mem pressure in infra.
ops-bot: Reminder: update API changelog and add migration notes if we persist previews.
Maria: Great. Feature-flag + sampled telemetry sounds safe. Thanks everyone.
